description: Defines configuration structures, interfaces, and constants for SCTP network gateway in the ocudu project, including port and protocol ID constants, configuration structs for server and client, and interface classes for data handling, control, and connection notification.

classes.name: sctp_network_gateway_data_handler
classes.description: Interface for injecting PDUs into the SCTP gateway.

classes.name: sctp_network_gateway_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling socket operations like listen, connect, and retrieving port.

classes.name: sctp_network_gateway_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about connection events.

classes.name: sctp_network_gateway
classes.description: Composite class inheriting controller and data handler interfaces for SCTP network gateway.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the socket is listening on.

methods.name: on_connection_established
methods.description: Callback invoked when a connection is established.

methods.name: on_connection_loss
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection is lost or cannot be established.
